name: Turmeric Fingers
title: Turmeric Fingers
description:
GOPU Exports supplies premium-quality turmeric fingers sourced from selected farms in Telangana, India. The product is carefully cleaned, naturally dried, and processed to maintain color, aroma, and curcumin quality suitable for international buyers.

Our turmeric fingers are widely used for spice grinding, food processing, herbal applications, and bulk export requirements. We support flexible packaging options and export-oriented procurement based on buyer specifications.

Product Features:
• Natural yellow color
• Export-quality sorting
• Properly cleaned and dried
• Strong aroma and high curcumin potential
• Suitable for bulk shipments

Applications:
• Spice manufacturing
• Food processing
• Turmeric powder production
• Herbal and ayurvedic industries

Packaging Options:
• PP bags
• Jute bags
• Custom export packaging available

MOQ:
Bulk orders accepted based on buyer requirement and destination.

Origin:
Nizamabad, Telangana, India
